usage: policy for webhooks directing to URLs with specific VT reputation
name: Webhook URLs must not have malicious reputation
description: A webhook URL should not be malicious based on Virus Total reputation.
detailedDescription: A malicious destination webhook URL may have been planted during a breach to gain visibility in changes to your code and environments.

args.label: Reputation
args.tooltip: Select on or more Virus Total reputations to generate the policy
